mods.name: Blaze Slayer Helper
mods.description: Passive Blaze Slayer overlay for Hypixel Skyblock (information only, no automation).

releases.notes:
This is the first release of the BlazeOverlay. Note that this version is specifically made for me, as this mod will only recognize entities that are "Catxna" spawns. 

# Blaze Slayer Helper v1.0.0: feature overview

**Fight HUD**
- Attunement and hits left, drawn under the crosshair for the whole fight, with a colour per attunement
- Tracks only your own boss, ignoring other players' bosses and Quazii's phase
- Twilight Arrow Poison indicator (20 seconds)

**Timers**
- Kill time for the whole fight, spawn time (quest start to boss spawn), and average full-quest time
- One-second popup after each kill, coloured green, gold or red against your session average

**Session tracker** (`/blaze tracker`)
- Top-left panel with session time, bosses killed, average kill, spawn and quest times, profit and profit per hour
- Drop list sorted by value, with counts and net coin values

**Profit tracking**
- Bazaar items valued at insta-sell, everything else at lowest BIN
- Optional Bazaar and Auction House tax modelling (`/blaze tax`)
- Quest cost per boss, with failed quests charged too (default 150k for Tier IV, adjustable with `/blaze cost`)
- Fixed values for a few items (runes, Kelvin Inverter, Nether Star and others)
- Prices refresh every 5 minutes in the background

**Gummy timer**
- Detects Re-heated Gummy Polar Bears from chat, stacks them at one hour each, and warns you 2 minutes before expiry
- Gummies eaten are counted as a cost in profit

**Utilities**
- `/blaze profit` for a full breakdown in chat
- `/blaze price <item>` and `/blaze ids` to check how items are priced
- `/blaze refresh` to re-download prices 
- `/blaze debug` and `/blaze scan` for bug reports

**Design**
- Client-side, passive and information-only: it reads chat and name tags and draws overlays, with no automation
- No API key needed, and nothing about you is sent anywhere

readmeSummary: Passive, information-only HUD and profit tracker for the Hypixel SkyBlock Inferno Demonlord (Blaze Slayer) fight.
